Initial release of go-writer-ai – an unofficial, typed Go client for the Writer API (writer.com):

- Supports chat, text completions, models, file uploads, Knowledge Graphs, no-code applications, PDF parser, web search, and vision.
- Returns parsed responses as `JSON200`; handles errors via the raw body.
- Authentication via Bearer API key, read from the WRITER_API_KEY environment variable.
- Suitable for projects already using Go and importing github.com/psyb0t/go-writer-ai.
- Includes code samples and security guidelines in SKILL.md.
